text.tspan: Share of girls enrolled in pre-primary school
Comparing net and gross enrollment ratios for girls in pre-primary education. Net enrollment shows the share of
girls of pre-primary school age (typically 3–5 years) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment includes all girls
regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of girls of the same age group.
Data source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2026); UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), via World Bank (2026)
